title: Copy List with Random Pointer
constraints: random is null or points to a node in the list
inputFormat: Implement copyRandomList(head). The runner builds nodes with val, next, and random fields from [value, randomIndex] pairs. randomIndex is zero-based; null means no random pointer. An empty array becomes null.
outputFormat: The head of a new, independent list preserving values and next/random relationships. Restore the original list before returning. No copied pointer may refer to an original node.
